[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lightroom Mobile: A powerful app from Adobe with advanced editing tools. (Free, with in-app purchases)

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Facetune: Popular for portrait editing, great for selfies and group shots. (Free, with in-app purchases)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. PicsArt: A versatile editor with tools, filters, and effects. (Free, with in-app purchases)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. TouchRetouch: For removing unwanted objects from photos. ($1.99)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Canva: A graphic design app also great for photo editing. (Free, with in-app purchases)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for editing photos:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Organize photos into albums or folders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Crop and straighten photos for better composition.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Adjust brightness, contrast, and saturation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Experiment with filters and presets.
